execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."Appointment" (
  "clinic_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "duration_minutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" text NOT NULL,
  "reason_for_visit" text,
  "scheduled_time" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Scheduled' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Appointment_status_check_9d570c59" CHECK ("status" IN ('Scheduled', 'Completed', 'Canceled', 'NoShow'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Clinic" (
  "clinic_type" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Invoice" (
  "appointment_id" text,
  "clinic_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "due_date" date,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'Unpaid' NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Invoice_status_check_ee68904d" CHECK ("status" IN ('Unpaid', 'Partial', 'Paid'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Patient" (
  "clinic_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "date_of_birth" date,
  "email" text,
  "first_name" text NOT NULL,
  "gender" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "specialized_data" json,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PatientDocument" (
  "document_type" text,
  "file_url" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" text NOT NULL,
  "uploaded_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Payment" (
  "amount" numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
  "clinic_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "invoice_id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "payment_date" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "payment_method" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Payment_payment_method_check_d203589d" CHECK ("payment_method" IN ('Cash', 'Card', 'Transfer', 'Insurance'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."SharedMedicalHistory" (
  "allergies" text,
  "blood_type" text,
  "chronic_conditions" text,
  "current_medications" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "last_updated" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "clinic_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "first_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "last_name" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_0a39af16" CHECK ("role" IN ('SuperAdmin', 'Admin', 'Staff'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserPermission" (
  "can_create" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "can_delete" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "can_edit" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "can_view" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "module_name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
